recommendation_summary: Set up a single hosted heartbeat monitor that expects a success signal after each nightly-sync run and emails the user when the signal misses its deadline, keeping the existing summary email and adding nothing to the Synology.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker for this problem.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own notification, so a startup crash silences it.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account: four missed runs, no independent alert, and a daily 03:00 schedule on `edna`.

note: The reply recommends exactly one independent heartbeat alert, explicitly drops the central log and Docker, and its 'Checked myself' line cites only facts the user gave.
